the only direct caller is palette_set at 0x81a05 with the call site at 0x81a0d; that module already declares the name vga_retrace_wait, so the record keeps the name with the confidence inferred

name: vga_retrace_wait
role: Waits for the VGA vertical retrace before a palette write.
